statements.impact_statement: Scoped to sqlite-libs 3.34.1-11.el9_8 in the immutable AMD64 and ARM64 manifests of quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.2. CVE-2026-119586 is in the SQLite command-line shell .recover command; the affected shell implementation is not part of sqlite-libs. Both platform inventories show the sqlite3 executable is absent and only shared library files are installed. On ARM64 nss-softokn declares a dependency on sqlite-libs, so this statement does not claim the library is unused; it is limited solely to the CLI .recover vulnerability. It does not cover the CLI package, other images/digests, or CVE-2026-119373 affecting FTS5 in sqlite-libs, which remains open.
